definitions: An abbreviation for Staff Selection Commission, an organization in India that recruits staff for various government departments and ministries.
An abbreviation for Superconducting Super Collider, a particle accelerator complex under construction in Texas, United States, from 1987 to 1993, but never completed.
examples: Many candidates apply for jobs through SSC.
The SSC project was ultimately canceled.
She prepared for the SSC examination.
